name: node-rollup
description: Minimal Node.js + Rollup app instrumented with PostHog error tracking and source map upload. `start` binds the uploaded symbol sets to a release the usual way; `start:releaseless` flips the plugin onto --release-mode=event: content-addressed chunk ids plus a release id injected into every chunk. The plugin and the SDK are local builds, since neither change has shipped, and so is the CLI (event mode needs `release resolve`).

scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm run:app
scripts.start:releaseless: pnpm clean && pnpm build:releaseless && pnpm run:app
